summary: Sarpang district is overwhelmingly forested, with forests covering 1,449.00 km² (87.6 %). The remaining land is dominated by agriculture land at 86.74 km² (5.2 %) and shrubs at 78.91 km² (4.8 %), while water bodies, sandy banks, built‑up areas, and other land‑use categories together comprise less than 1 % of the district.
